t.CETEARYL_ALCOHOL.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.CETEARYL_ALCOHOL.eff.0: In the EU there is no health warning or usage limit specific to this substance. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.CETEARYL_ALCOHOL.summary: A fatty alcohol made of cetyl and stearyl alcohol; it is not a drying alcohol (ethanol).
t.CETEARYL_ALCOHOL.what: Thickens creams, helps keep oil and water mixed, and softens the skin.
